fixed_in_this_lane.mechanism: BoundedDiscoveryEngine: 20s per-source deadline, 12s request timeout, 5s connect timeout, retries stop when the budget is gone, extra HostLimiter removed (HTTP already paces rpm / crawl-delay). A stall is recorded as SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with elapsed time and the campaign continues.
embed_pngs batches one forward pass on the selected device.

diagnosis.observed_before: kind held the stage for 82-95s with 10 serial HTTP fetches of 8-12s. byronesque added 45s. wikimedia 29s. The UI stage string does not change while engine.run walks sources.

owned_by_other_lane.mechanism: engine.run walks SourcePlans one at a time. _run_plan pops a frontier batch then fetches each URL in a Python for-loop. No per-source wall deadline. max_work=8 plus query seeds produced 10 kind fetches on this host.

Escalator.host_limiter.wait (token bucket at rpm) then HonestHttpClient DomainLimiter at crawl-delay or 60/rpm. Two sleeps on the same host. kind rpm=12 so ~5s+5s plus the GET, matching the measured 8-12s fetches. Retries on NETWORK_FAILED/SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE up to 4 with backoff up to 30s; a true hang is ~4*20s + backoff.
Default timeout=20s connect=10s. DomainLimiter.acquire sleeps the crawl-delay with no remaining-time check.

STAGE_LANGUAGE maps PLANNING_SOURCES and DISCOVERING to 'Searching international sources'. _discover calls engine.run with no stage deadline. _acquire downloads listing images serially (~50s after discovery on this host).

embedding_images_per_second.note: No DINOv2 weights in this tree and the uv env has no torch. embed_pngs() batches on the existing device when weights exist. A cheap CPU stub was not a valid throughput proxy.

remaining_floor_ms.why: After per-source 20s deadlines, this host still spends ~20s on reference, ~60s walking wikimedia+kind+byronesque serially at the deadline, and ~50s in orchestrator._acquire downloading listing images one at a time. Those last two live in denied files.
